function drawModel(model,placement,clipY,tint){const j=model.j;for(let index=0;index<j.nodes.length;index++){const node=j.nodes[index];if(node.mesh===undefined)continue;const local=model.world[index],world=mMul(placement,local),mesh=model.prims[node.mesh];let bones=null;if(node.skin!==undefined){const skin=model.skins[node.skin],inv=mInvert(local);bones=new Float32Array(64*16);for(let k=0;k<64;k++)bones.set(mIdentity(),k*16);for(let k=0;k<Math.min(64,skin.joints.length);k++){const joint=skin.joints[k],ib=skin.ibm?skin.ibm.slice(k*16,k*16+16):mIdentity();bones.set(mMul(mMul(inv,model.world[joint]),ib),k*16)}}

function draw(now){if(!gl)return;const t=now/1000,dt=Math.min(.05,t-last||.016);last=t;resize();updateMovement(dt);gl.viewport(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);gl.clearColor(.055,.091,.131,1);gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT|gl.DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);gl.enable(gl.DEPTH_TEST);gl.disable(gl.CULL_FACE);gl.useProgram(program);let focus=actorState.mode==='follow'?[actorState.x,actorState.y+2,actorState.z]:actorState.destination==='outside'?[-7,13,3]:[actorState.x,actorState.y+1.8,actorState.z];const a=1-Math.exp(-dt*5);cams.target=cams.target.map((v,i)=>v+(focus[i]-v)*a);const dist=cams.dist,eye=[cams.target[0]+dist*Math.sin(cams.yaw)*Math.cos(cams.pitch),cams.target[1]+dist*Math.sin(cams.pitch),cams.target[2]+dist*Math.cos(cams.yaw)*Math.cos(cams.pitch)],vp=mMul(perspective(Math.PI/3,canvas.width/Math.max(1,canvas.height),.08,500),lookAt(eye,cams.target));gl.uniformMatrix4fv(U.uVP,false,vp);let clipY=actorState.y+3.8;if(models.campus){updatePose(models.campus,0,null);drawModel(models.campus,mIdentity(),clipY,0)}const actor=models[actorState.kind];if(actor){updatePose(actor,t,actorAnimation(actor));const placement=mTRS([actorState.x,actorState.y,actorState.z],[0,Math.sin(actorState.dir/2),0,Math.cos(actorState.dir/2)],[1,1,1]);drawModel(actor,placement,1000,0)}requestAnimationFrame(draw)}
function resize(){const pixelRatio=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,1.6),w=Math.round(canvas.clientWidth*pixelRatio),h=Math.round(canvas.clientHeight*pixelRatio);if(canvas.width!==w||canvas.height!==h){canvas.width=w;canvas.height=h}}
async function main(){if(!gl){softwareFallback();return}try{initShader();gl.enable(gl.DEPTH_TEST);for(const key of ['campus','worker','operator']){loader.textContent='Parsing actual GLB: '+key;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,20));models[key]=buildDraws(parseGLB(fromBase64(EMBEDDED[key])));statusEl.textContent=`Loaded ${key}`;}loader.textContent='3 native GLB assets loaded';setTimeout(()=>loader.style.display='none',2500);teleport();start=performance.now();requestAnimationFrame(draw);window.__scalpCityTest={modelsReady:true,modelCounts:Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(models).map(([k,m])=>[k,{nodes:m.j.nodes.length,meshes:m.j.meshes.length,animations:m.animations.map(x=>x.name),skins:m.skins.length}]))};}catch(e){fail('GLB engine: '+e.message);console.error(e)}}main();
</script></body></html>
